: We’re family...so we have to look out for each other, right?
lines.zh: : 我们是家人……家人就该互相照顾,对吧?

lines.en: : Isn’t it hard having all that pent up energy down there?
lines.zh: : 那里憋着那么多精力,很难受吧?

lines.en: : Don’t you get super turned on when you play with me?
lines.zh: : 跟我玩的时候,你不也兴奋得不行?

lines.en: : Let me touch you...the same way you touch me.
lines.zh: : 让我摸你……用你摸我的那种方式。

lines.en: scene amifirstlust14
with dissolve
: I can tell you're excited just by looking at you, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 光是看着你,我就知道你很兴奋了,Sensei。

lines.en: : And I am too...My heart is beating so fast right now.
lines.zh: : 我也是……我的心跳得好快。

lines.en: : It was never ever this bad until you started putting your fingers inside of me.
lines.zh: : 直到你开始把手指放进我身体,才变得这么严重。

lines.en: : Let me repay you for that.
lines.zh: : 让我为此报答你。

lines.en: : Let me show you I'm not just a bad girl who thinks about her uncle all day long.
lines.zh: : 让你看到,我不只是个满脑子都是叔叔的坏女孩。

lines.en: scene amifirstlust15
with dissolve
: Let me show you I'm a bad girl who actually gets to touch him...who gets to please him...
lines.zh: : 让你看到,我是真的能碰到他……能侍奉他的坏女孩……

lines.en: : Sensei...I want to do this...
lines.zh: : Sensei……我想做……

lines.en: : I want to do this right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在就想做。

lines.en: I can see an insatiable lust forming in Ami’s eyes that quickly begins to spread throughout the rest of her body.
lines.zh: 我能看见 Ami 眼中成形的、贪得无厌的欲望,正飞快蔓延到她全身。

lines.en: I feel like even if I refused her right now, (Which I obviously wouldn't) she’d just force herself on me anyway.
lines.zh: 我觉得就算我现在拒绝她(我显然不会),她也会强行来。

lines.en: Not like I’d be opposed since I'm already nearly bursting out of my pants...
lines.zh: 反正我也不会抗拒,毕竟我已经快从裤子里撑爆了……

lines.en: In fact, I think it would be cute for her to be that aggressive.
lines.zh: 事实上,她要是这么主动,我觉得还挺可爱的。

lines.en: But...
lines.zh: 不过……

lines.en: Maybe there’s something else I can get out of this deal as well?
lines.zh: 说不定这笔交易里,我还能捞到点别的?

lines.en: : You can touch me as much as you want.
lines.zh: : 你想摸多少次都可以。

lines.en: : Good. Because I-
lines.zh: : 好。因为我——

lines.en: : But there is one thing I want to ask you to do first.
lines.zh: : 不过有一件事,想先请你做。

lines.en: scene amifirstlust16
with dissolve
: Huh? Of course. Anything you want, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 嗯?当然。什么都行,Sensei。

lines.en: : I want you to stop calling me that.
lines.zh: : 别再那样叫我。

lines.en: : You...want me to stop calling you Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你……想让我别再叫你 Sensei?

lines.en: : Correct.
lines.zh: : 正确。

lines.en: : Well...what would you want me to call you instead, then?
lines.zh: : 那……你想让我叫你什么?
